user.title: Charge Ahead
user.description: Plans charging from the trips in a calendar. Each timed event with a location is a trip.

routing.title: Routing
routing.description: Travel time and distance from home to the trip location.

data_description.routing_provider: Uses an existing travel time integration.

vehicle.title: Vehicle
vehicle.description: Entities take precedence over fixed values when they have a valid state.

data_description.soc_entity: Together with range, used to derive the current consumption.
data_description.range_entity: The car's own range estimate in km.
data_description.consumption_kwh_per_100km: Used when state of charge or range is not available.
data_description.soc_limit_entity: A warning is sent when a trip needs more than this limit.
data_description.charge_power_kw: Decides whether the time at home between two trips is enough to recharge.

data_description.departure_buffer_min: Leave this much earlier than the travel time requires.
data_description.reserve_percent: State of charge left after the round trip.
data_description.soc_step: The target SoC is rounded up to this step.
data_description.look_ahead_days: How far ahead the calendar is read.
data_description.notify_target: A notify entity (notify.xyz) or a notify action such as notify.mobile_app_iphone. Optional.

target.title: Plan target
target.description: Where should the computed target SoC and departure time go?

target_none.title: No target
target_none.description: Charge Ahead only provides the plan as sensors. Use them in your own automations.

target_entities.title: Target entities
target_entities.description: Charge Ahead writes the target SoC and the departure time into these entities.

target_action.title: Target actions
target_action.description: Available variables: target_soc (%), departure (ISO 8601 with offset), departure_local (local time, YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS) and energy_kwh. Templates only work in YAML mode: open the action menu (three dots) and choose Edit in YAML. See the README for an evcc example.

data_description.set_action: Runs when a plan is created or changes.
data_description.clear_action: Runs when the trip is gone before departure. Optional.

error.google_entry_required: Select a Google Maps Travel Time entry.
error.notify_not_found: No notify entity or action with this name.
